notes: Author claims: the six-operation formalism implicitly contains the definition of homology and an essential identity between the homological and cohomological notions named on the page. The noun is still uncertain in the transcription.

Author gives cases with quasi-coherent sheaves on schemes (Hartshorne seminar), topological spaces with arbitrary coefficients (Verdier/Bourbaki), étale cohomology with the stated coefficient qualification (SGA 5), and an interlinear analytic coherent-sheaf case attributed to Verdier and a name read Ruget with a diacritic doubt.

Author says the formalism remains to be developed in crystalline settings and, in characteristic 0, for stratified modules, with the inserted words à singularités. He mentions Deligne, Hodge structures over the doubled C, and motives.

The explicit qualifications je suis persuadé and partout, peut-être are authorial uncertainty/conviction, not reader proof conclusions. There is no date, salutation or closing on this sheet; author page 7 and archive pencil 152 are both present.

The final sentence begins an étale-cohomology setup on a scheme of finite type over k, with inserted séparé and torsion coefficients Lambda prime to the clipped characteristic abbreviation. It is unfinished on this image. No other page was consulted.

Mathematical expectations prompted visual inspection of the exceptional exclamation marks, the Lf exponent, derived L/R lettering, 0, doubled C, k and Lambda. Those inspections are not proof checks. No mathematical statement was proved, re-proved, computed, or used as a checked background lemma.

Four independent guides are reproduced in TikZ. The right-hand guide contains a semicolon whose exact baseline association is not forced. The long rule below premiers … résiduelles is an underline, not a cancellation of the phrase.

Two small detached marks omitted by both witnesses are recorded with explicit uncertainty and retained at their vertical positions: one above the middle of aux, and one beneath the start of un. A further possible diacritic in Ruget remains a reader doubt.

No slip or mathematical correction is proposed. Different dash-length TeX encodings and the l/ell handwriting representation are not counted as separate errors. Quote-shape rows record visible high pairs, while acknowledging H may employ house guillemets.

coverage: The whole image was viewed once solely to establish layout and inventory; half a and then half b were each viewed once and read sequentially line by line against complete C and H, including every agreed word and mathematical sign. The main text occupies 25 physical baseline rows, with four interlinear additions. Every index/exponent, exceptional sign, quote pair, accent, punctuation mark, deletion, underline, insertion, guide, marginal foliation and clipped final line was inspected. There are no mathematical displays or diagrams on this page; the four textual guide drawings are encoded completely in TikZ. Ten tight crops were generated once each with crop.py and viewed once each; no decided place was recropped or whole half enlarged again. The split noun has both source boxes recorded, with only its unresolved first segment cropped. Both witnesses omit the guide drawings and the two detached marks; H also misreads several words and the underline state. C’s seven doubt locations are individually resolved or retained in the changes list, including its final comma, for which no ink survives. The reading is a full-page transcription rather than a patch. No OCR, external sources, other pages, readers, decisions or LaTeX compilation were used.
